r15-things.title: One record per ticket, task or chore (with mockups)
body: You liked the recommendations; these mockups show every place the change is visible, so you can check them before I build. Step 1 (one item per ticket number) changes nothing on screen, so I'm starting it now.
The full write-up is in [Tickets, plans and projects: one clearer model](https://claude.ai/artifact/KhY1cyvt1PcBJYiGYSzyEZ).
bullets: **The bell:** each item once, with Open, Tomorrow and Done, instead of separate brought-up, pin and still-open lines.
**Menus:** Bring up tomorrow and the pin's chase day become one **Follow up** submenu. A pin just keeps it on the bottom bar.
**Log work and the tray:** a title you've used before asks "Add to ...?"; a ticket Shiftbook knows shows its notepad, project and time so far.
**Items view:** every ticket, task and chore in one list (Open, Follow up, Done), filtered by project or kind. It takes over the Done tickets board.
**On the Desk:** tasks and chores become cards that sit in project boxes, with ticks and a Mark done.

r15-items-extras.title: Extras that items make easy
body: You asked for more ideas. These all build on items, so they're small once step 1 is in. Tell me which to mock up; I'll bring mockups before building any of them.
bullets: **Waiting on someone:** mark an item "waiting on Sam". It leaves your open count and comes back in the bell after 2 days (changeable).
**Ticket age:** still-open tickets show "open 6 days", turning orange after a week, so old ones don't hide.
**Project budget on its box:** "6.5 h of 20 h", and Over budget or Overdue in orange. The rules are already written and tested.
**Todos from notes:** a `[]` line in a meeting or daily note becomes a task item with one click, linked back to the note.
**Start my day from items:** Next up offers the items you're following up today and yesterday's still-open tickets as one-click lines.
